meta.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
meta.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行执行多个独立任务，无需等待顺序完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时处理多个互不依赖的任务
copy.tagline_en: Execute multiple independent tasks in parallel without waiting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to handle multiple independent tasks simultaneously

howto.what: 遇到多个互不相关的问题时,Claude 会为每个问题域各派一个独立子代理,在同一轮响应里并发运行;每个代理拿到专属、自洽的指令,不继承当前会话历史。代理返回后,Claude 阅读总结、核对改动是否冲突,并跑完整测试套件。
howto.when: 当你面对 2 个以上彼此独立、无共享状态、无先后依赖的任务时触发,比如 3 个以上根因不同的测试失败文件。相关或会互相干扰的失败则改由一个代理串行处理。

say.text: 这三个测试文件都挂了,分别派一个代理去修
say.note: 同一响应里并发派出全部子代理

say.text: 让一个代理只修 agent-tool-abort.test.ts 的失败
say.note: 该代理只动这个文件并返回总结

say.text: 先判断这些失败是否相互独立,再决定并行还是串行
say.note: 相关或共享状态的失败改为串行

howto.what_en: Claude dispatches one subagent per independent problem domain and issues them in a single response, so they run in parallel with focused, self-contained instructions. It then reviews each summary, checks conflicts, and runs the full suite.
howto.when_en: Triggered by 2+ independent tasks with no shared state or sequential dependencies, e.g. 3+ failing test files with different root causes. Related failures use one agent instead.

say_en.text: Three test files are failing - send one agent per file to fix them
say_en.note: All three dispatch in one response and run in parallel

say_en.text: Have one agent fix only the failures in agent-tool-abort.test.ts
say_en.note: That agent touches only that file and returns a summary

say_en.text: Check whether these failures are independent before going parallel
say_en.note: Related or shared-state work runs sequentially instead
